distant-lr.construction: TF-IDF + LR fitted on train openers weakly labelled by the seed rules

llm.construction: prompted with the locked codebook; no human labels in the prompt

llm_mock.construction: prompted with the locked codebook; no human labels in the prompt

rule.construction: first-match-wins seed regex written against train text before any labelling; nothing is fitted

distant-lr-score.construction: distant-supervision LR probability mass on the intents the codebook marks escalation_role=independent; threshold 0.5 fixed a priori, NOT tuned (no labelled dev set exists, D23)

keyword.construction: union of profile.MUST_PROXY regexes plus the DM-follow-up marker, all written against train text; nothing fitted

lookup-codebook-distant-lr.construction: codebook escalation_role applied to the 'distant-lr' predicted intent; no human label enters either stage

lookup-codebook-rule.construction: codebook escalation_role applied to the 'rule' predicted intent; no human label enters either stage

lookup-oracle.construction: each intent mapped to its MAJORITY escalation decision in the golden set, applied to the GOLD intent

never-escalate.construction: constant AUTO_OK; coverage 100%, unsafe-auto = the base rate
